scheme1_name: Skill Loan Scheme (Model Skill Loan Scheme)
scheme2_name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana - Short Term Training (PMKVY)

comparisons.scheme1_value: Provides loans (Rs. 5,000–1,50,000) to pay for skill training courses so no one is denied education due to lack of money.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Offers FREE skill training with soft skills, entrepreneurship, and digital literacy to school/college dropouts and unemployed youth.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Any individual who has secured admission in an NSQF-aligned course from ITIs, polytechnics, colleges, or recognised training partners.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Indian nationals aged 15–45 years who are school/college dropouts or unemployed, with Aadhaar card and Aadhaar-linked bank account.

comparisons.scheme1_value: You must take a loan and repay it (3–7 years depending on amount). Interest = base rate + up to 1.5%. NO collateral required.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Completely FREE training. No loan, no repayment. You get allowances for travel, food, and boarding if eligible.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Loan covers course fees, assessment, exams, and study materials. Loan is disbursed directly to the training institute. Moratorium (no repayment) during course.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Free training + accidental insurance + one-time stipend after certification + placement travel cost + post-placement support + extra help for persons with disabilities.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Identity proof, address proof, income proof (of self/guardian if available), admission proof to NSQF course.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Aadhaar card (mandatory at enrolment). Other documents as required by the chosen job role.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Register on Vidya Kaushal or Jan Samarth portal → select sector/role → visit centre for counselling → request loan → accept offer → loan disbursed to institute.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Find nearest training centre at pmkvyofficial.org/trainingcenter → contact centre directly to apply, OR register via Skill India Digital portal.

comparisons.scheme1_value: No deadline. Apply anytime after securing admission to a recognised course.
comparisons.scheme2_value: No fixed deadline. Training batches run year-round at centres; contact your nearest centre for next batch dates.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Any NSQF-aligned course (no minimum duration). Includes certificates, diplomas, and degrees.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Short-term training for various job roles. Durations vary by role. Includes NSQF courses + soft skills + entrepreneurship + digital literacy.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Bank pays the institute DIRECTLY—you don't get cash in hand. Protects funds from misuse.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Minimum 70% attendance is mandatory to take the final assessment. Miss this and you may not get certified.

comparisons.scheme1_value: NO collateral can be demanded. Loans backed by Credit Guarantee Fund (75% guarantee). If a bank asks for collateral, that violates the scheme.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Aadhaar is MANDATORY at enrolment. You cannot enrol without it.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Interest accrues (builds up) even during the moratorium period (course duration), even though you don't repay yet.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Higher-level courses (NSQF 5+) may be fee-based; however, weaker and marginalised sections continue to receive support.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Someone with admission to a skill course who has the ability to repay a loan over 3–7 years and wants to avoid debt.
comparisons.scheme2_value: School/college dropouts or unemployed youth aged 15–45 who want FREE training, no repayment, and immediate placement support.
Skill India Digital: skillindiadigital.gov.in | Training Centres: pmkvyofficial.org/trainingcenter | Ministry: msde.gov.in

recommendation: **Choose Skill Loan Scheme if:** You have admission to a specific NSQF course and can repay a loan—it gives you flexibility in course choice and duration. **Choose PMKVY STT if:** You are a school/college dropout or unemployed, aged 15–45, have Aadhaar, and want FREE training with guaranteed placement support—no debt burden. **Simple Analogy:** Skill Loan = someone gives you money for school, but you pay it back later. PMKVY = the government pays for your school AND helps you find a job. Both are run by the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship. For final decisions, check official websites or contact Jan Samarth (1800-123-9626) or your nearest PMKVY centre. **Disclaimer:** This is AI guidance based on official records, not an official notification. Always verify with ministry portals before applying.
